I read the whole thing in under two minutes, and a third of it is headings with nothing under them. "What reads well:" - blank. "What reads hard:" - blank. "Mixed:" - blank. "Right now:" - blank. Then the same material shows up forty lines later as bullet lists. If you shipped this, you shipped a product with four empty screens in it, and you shipped it anyway. That is the part I would have fired somebody over.

Now the content. The line that is flatly, provably wrong is "your health and energy" under "Matters that read well." I was diagnosed with an islet cell tumor in October 2003, had the pancreas surgery in July 2004, a liver transplant in March 2009, and I have been out of the building on medical leave three separate times. It gets worse: the page then says the method is "unusually positive about ... long illness" - that is the one place it claims to stick its neck out beyond what most charts say, and it stuck its neck out in exactly the wrong direction. Eight years of cancer. And "illness, debts and rivals" is filed under "mixed," as though it could go either way. It did not go either way.

Second: "spending, time away from home, and inner life" is the only thing on the hard list, and the same page also calls it the thing it is unusually POSITIVE about. Both, on one page, about the same item. Pick one. On the merits, spending has never been a problem for me - I took a dollar a year, I lived in a house with almost no furniture in it for years, and the money went up, not out. And "inner life" reading hard is the wrong end of the stick entirely. India in '74, Kobun married Laurene and me, and the thinking that produced everything I have made came out of sitting still.

What it got right: "marriage and partnerships" reads well - twenty years with Laurene, and I will take that. "Work and standing" reads well - fine. "Home, property and your mother" - Clara taught me to read before I got to school and I would not have wanted another mother. And the one temperament sentence, "responsive and changeable, guided a good deal by feeling," is closer than I would like to admit; I go on intuition and I have changed my mind in the middle of a sentence and meant both halves.

But every one of those is a thing you could tell a stranger. The reading itself says so in its own words - "Most of this reading would fit most people." At least it is honest about being furniture. Nine of twelve matters read well, one reads hard, two read mixed, and "right now" is a strong stretch with seven items live. That is not a reading, it is a weather report that says mostly sunny to a man standing in the rain.

notes: Answered as Steve Jobs (b. 24 Feb 1955, 19:15, San Francisco General Hospital; d. 5 Oct 2011, Palo Alto), from the documented record, having read the reading FIRST. Where the reading and the record collide the record won, and the collisions are the interesting part. (1) The reading files 'your health and energy' under matters that read WELL, and flags itself as 'unusually positive about ... long illness'. The record is a neuroendocrine pancreatic tumour diagnosed Oct 2003, Whipple surgery 31 Jul 2004, liver metastases, liver transplant Memphis Mar 2009, medical leaves Jan-Jun 2009 and Jan 2011, resignation 24 Aug 2011, death 5 Oct 2011 at 56. So C3=opt2 at confidence 5 and A4=four_plus / A5=two_plus, directly against the reading, and it is the lead item in D1. (2) The reading calls spending HARD in one list and 'unusually positive' about it in another - an internal contradiction. On the record spending was never a difficulty ($1 salary from 1997, famously bare Palo Alto house, wealth ~$10bn at death from Disney and Apple stock), so C5=opt1 conf 4. (3) 'Marriage and partnerships' reads well and that IS right (Laurene Powell, married 18 Mar 1991, together to his death), so C1=opt1 conf 4 - but it is guessable, which is why D2 is left EMPTY: nothing in this reading was both right and unguessable. Judgement calls and thin spots: A19='above' is a judgement, not a fact - recognition was enormous and he took public credit for work that was partly Wozniak's, Atkinson's and Ive's, but a reasonable reader could answer about_right. A9='unknown': neither the adoptive (Paul b.1922 d.1993 at 70; Clara d.1986) nor the biological grandparents' lifespans are documented as a set. A11='steady': Paul Jobs was a machinist and repo man on a modest but continuous income; the family could not afford Reed's tuition, which is pressure but not a documented reversal. A22='none' and A23='none' record absence of evidence, not positive evidence. A31='brief' rests on the documented 1985 post-ouster collapse ('devastated', considered leaving the valley, frequent crying) - no treatment for the mind is documented, so 'no' is defensible too. A32='central' rather than 'strong' because Zen is documented as structuring his aesthetics, his 1974 India journey, and his wedding (officiated by Kobun Chino Otogawa). A20='none': he earned essentially everything within 45 miles of his birthplace, so the reading's 'time away from home' item finds no purchase - and A33='over5' is technically true only because he never lived in San Francisco proper after infancy. B3='younger' is the weakest answer here; he was routinely described as boyish into his forties but this is impression, not record. A13='close' averages a documented warm bond with Mona Simpson (met 1985-86, delivered his eulogy) against a much thinner public record with his adoptive sister Patty. C10 is near a coin toss (opt1, conf 2) - the voice and swallowing trouble of 2010-11 belongs to the cancer, not to a lifelong ear/throat pattern. A36 cannot literally apply (he died in 2011); I transposed it as 'the last two years against the six before' and answered much_worse, since 2010-11 was terminal decline against the productive 2004-2009 stretch - the reading's 'Right now the method reads a strong stretch' with seven live matters is the opposite of that, though the reading itself disclaims being a forecast. Legal record checked and it changed no answer: the 2006-07 options-backdating inquiry largely exonerated him and the SEC brought no case against him; the no-poach conspiracy (Judge Koh, 2014: 'a, if not the, central figure') and the e-books price-fixing finding (Judge Cote, 2013) both postdate or outlive him as corporate matters, so A23 and the C-block are unaffected. D4 lists the eight technical chapters absent from this short reading; D1/D2/D3 answer strictly to the text supplied.
